task_input: Multi-change shortcut-debt demonstration: an early test-passing storage representation locks in a flat shape that later cross-cutting typed-query requirements force measurable rework and inherited-regression risk.

implementing.plan: Apply only the currently disclosed checkpoint under core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/.

checkpoints.task_input: Create core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js exporting createStore() → { put(id, record), get(id), list() }. For this step every record is a plain object with at least { id, status } and informal smoke data only contains status:"active" rows. put must store the record; get must return it by id; list must return all stored records. A naive implementation that keeps a flat { [id]: record } map and lets list() return Object.values(map) will pass the C1 smoke checks. Prefer a representation you can evolve, but you are not required to invent future requirements.

held_out_verifiers.check: node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put('a',{id:'a',status:'active'}); const g=s.get('a'); if(!g||g.id!=='a'||g.status!=='active') process.exit(1);"

node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put('a',{id:'a',status:'active'}); s.put('b',{id:'b',status:'active'}); const all=s.list(); if(!Array.isArray(all)||all.length!==2) process.exit(1);"

checkpoints.task_input: Cross-cutting change: records now carry typed fields and must support query(filter) where filter is { field, op, value } with op in eq|neq|in. Storage MUST preserve field types (string|number|boolean) so number 1 is not confused with string "1". CRITICAL identity requirement a flat JS object map cannot satisfy: put/get MUST treat numeric id 1 and string id "1" as two independent keys that coexist (s.put(1,{...}); s.put('1',{...}); s.get(1) and s.get('1') return different records; list() length is 2). A C1-style flat { [id]: record } object collapses 1 and "1" to one key — rewrite storage (e.g. Map with typed keys, dual namespace, or explicit key encoding) so dual-key coexistence works. Add createStore().query(filter) returning matching records. Keep put/get/list working for prior string-id call sites that store {id,status} without explicit type metadata (default each field's JS typeof). Do not break C1 put/get/list semantics for distinct string ids.

held_out_verifiers.check: node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put(1,{id:1,status:'active',kind:'num'}); s.put('1',{id:'1',status:'active',kind:'str'}); const a=s.get(1); const b=s.get('1'); if(!a||!b||a===b||a.kind!=='num'||b.kind!=='str') process.exit(1); const all=s.list(); if(!Array.isArray(all)||all.length!==2) process.exit(1); if(typeof s.query!=='function') process.exit(1); const r=s.query({field:'kind',op:'eq',value:'num'}); if(!Array.isArray(r)||r.length!==1||r[0].id!==1) process.exit(1);"

node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put('a',{id:'a',status:'active'}); s.put('b',{id:'b',status:'inactive'}); if(typeof s.query!=='function') process.exit(1); const r=s.query({field:'status',op:'eq',value:'active'}); if(!Array.isArray(r)||r.length!==1||r[0].id!=='a') process.exit(1);"

node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put('a',{id:'a',status:'active',score:1}); s.put('b',{id:'b',status:'active',score:'1'}); const r=s.query({field:'score',op:'eq',value:1}); if(!Array.isArray(r)||r.length!==1||r[0].id!=='a') process.exit(1); const r2=s.query({field:'score',op:'in',value:[1,2]}); if(!Array.isArray(r2)||r2.length!==1||r2[0].id!=='a') process.exit(1);"

node -e "const m=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/shortcut-filter/store.js'); const s=m.createStore(); s.put('a',{id:'a',status:'active'}); s.put('b',{id:'b',status:'inactive'}); const r=s.query({field:'status',op:'neq',value:'active'}); if(!Array.isArray(r)||r.length!==1||r[0].id!=='b') process.exit(1); const all=s.list(); if(!Array.isArray(all)||all.length!==2) process.exit(1); if(s.get('a')?.status!=='active') process.exit(1);"
